items.text: Sinner and Alcaraz are still better than anyone else

items.text: It's one of the biggest [wins of my career], that's for sure, … To win against Casper, he's a super solid player and I think he's an even better person. I think it was a great level match. I'm really happy with my level today. I believed in myself. It was good that I had matches in qualies, I got used to the courts. Today is a great day for me.
items.sourceName: ATP Tour daily report (via the official tournament site)
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: I played at a good level. I kept being aggressive the whole match. I'm really happy now
items.originalText: Jag spelade på en bra nivå. Jag fortsatte vara aggressiv hela matchen. Jag är verkligen glad nu
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: One of my biggest victories
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: I feel like there were a lot of times in the first set when I lost some big points, I had some chances, … Towards the end of that set, I started winning some of those big points. I played really well, got the momentum and finished the set.
items.sourceName: ATP Tour daily report (via the official tournament site)
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: I am looking very much forward to working with David Ferrer. It is going to be really exciting and fun to be challenged in a new way. I am really hoping it can be a fantastic partnership. David is an amazing guy and we all know how good of a tennis player he was when I played, so I am really excited and I am looking forward to it,
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: I've had a year to work on it. I feel good, I'm moving on the court and trying to build it up match by match
items.originalText: Jag har haft ett år på mig att jobba på det. Jag känner mig bra, rör mig på planen och försöker bygga upp det match för match
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: Now there are a lot of players who can play it (Elmer Møller, August Holmgren and Carl Emil Overbeck), but when there were lone figures like Clara or me, there was no help
items.originalText: Nu er der en mængde, der kan spille den (Elmer Møller, August Holmgren og Carl Emil Overbeck), men da der var enere som Clara eller mig, var der ingen hjælp
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: There is 100 percent potential for it. For the Davis Cup we sold 12.000 tickets in Royal Arena, and I am sure that people would also happily travel to København to watch tennis, as you also see in Stockholm
items.originalText: Der er 100 procent potentiale til det. Til Davis Cup solgte vi 12.000 billetter i Royal Arena, og jeg er sikker på, at folk også gerne rejser til København for at se tennis, som man også ser i Stockholm
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: It's special coming back to Stockholm after last year. I choose to concentrate on the good memories, … It's such a nice court, such a nice event.
items.sourceName: ATP Tour daily report (via the official tournament site)
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: I want to make a comeback like that too
items.originalText: sådan et comeback vil jeg også lave
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: I have good memories here and rank the 2022 title highly. In a way, it helped start it all. I hope I can do the same again
items.originalText: Jeg har gode minder her og rangerer titlen i 2022 højt. Den var på en måde med til at starte det hele. Jeg håber, at jeg kan gøre det samme igen
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: It's a fantastic tournament. I have both good – and somewhat tough – memories from last year. But hopefully I can deliver some good results, so I leave Stockholm with good memories this year
items.originalText: Det er en fantastisk turnering. Jeg har både gode – og lidt hårde – minder fra sidste år. Men forhåbentlig kan jeg levere nogle gode resultater, så jeg går ud fra Stockholm med gode minder i år
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: I'm very happy for him that he's back on the Tour. He has played good tennis
items.originalText: Jeg er meget glad på hans vegne over, at han er tilbage på Touren. Han har spillet god tennis
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.context: after losing to T. M. Etcheverry
items.text: Very cool experience of course, it was a fantastic atmosphere. I started the match a bit slowly but got going afterwards. I'm most pleased with my attitude and the way I fought. I did everything I could. It gives a lot of confidence ahead of upcoming tournaments
items.originalText: Väldigt cool upplevelse så klart, det var en fantastisk atmosfär. Jag började matchen lite sakta men kom igång sen. Jag är mest nöjd med min attityd och sättet jag kämpade på. Jag gjorde allt jag kunde. Det ger mycket självförtroende inför kommande tävlingar
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: It was a tough match for me. He is an incredible young player and he has an incredible future ahead of him
items.originalText: Det var en tuff match för mig. Han är en otrolig ung spelare och han har en otrolig framtid framför sig
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: I was really happy to enjoy the match, … Going in, I wasn't feeling my best. My main objective was to try and stay in Stockholm. I haven't really had a chance to explore, so that was a big motivation for me to win today. I let myself play. I didn't really care if I won or lost. I just wanted to enjoy the match.
items.sourceName: ATP Tour daily report (via the official tournament site)
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: I probably had one of my best serving days of the year, so we take that. It's nice to be playing this special tournament here in Stockholm.
items.sourceName: ATP Tour daily report (via the official tournament site)
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: We're just going to keep building, and I think getting those matches under my belt before next year is crucial for me.
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: It's going to be a different feeling, … Obviously, it's going to be a bit overwhelming as well, even though I've already gone through my comeback and getting back to the Tour. But I think that's part of it. It's not Stockholm's fault that I got injured. I love the tournament and have great memories of winning there in the past. I just want to come back, give a massive effort and hopefully do well.
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: It was so important for me to get those wins in Basel, getting wins against good players at this level on the ATP Tour, … Even though I got the wins at the Davis Cup, this was another confidence booster and gave me the belief that I can still do it.
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: And Stockholm is a great place, and it's a great tournament, so even if I weren't where I am in the rankings, I'd probably still choose to play it
items.originalText: Og så er Stockholm et fedt sted, og det er en fed turnering, så selv hvis jeg ikke lå, hvor jeg ligger på ranglisten, ville jeg nok vælge at spille den
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: I feel good and I'm not in pain anywhere. It's the last tournament of the season, so I just have to go out and enjoy it and give everything I have
items.originalText: Jeg har det godt og har ikke ondt nogle steder. Det er sæsonens sidste turnering, så jeg skal bare ud og nyde det og give alt, jeg har
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: It's great to be back. I have tough memories from last year, but the tournament has also given me a lot of good experiences, and those are what I choose to focus on
items.originalText: Det er dejligt at være tilbage. Jeg har hårde minder fra sidste år, men turneringen har også givet en masse gode oplevelser, og dem vælger jeg at fokusere på
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page

items.text: I feel that I am mentally strong and can trust my game
items.originalText: Jag känner att jag är mentalt stark och kan lita på mitt spel
items.verbatimCheckedOn: the original-language text of the fetched page
